minimum_scope: After source872 commit and separate authorization, change only checkpoint_inheritance.expand; keep all renderer, restorer, codec, privacy, collection and snapshot semantics unchanged.

findings.finding: data_cache is populated by add, but full-page PDF/ledger/trace reads and preserve_native_pin blob reads bypass it. A cache miss in data() also does not memoize; globally changing that behavior would retain every initial PNG read in line85 and is not recommended.

Native/overview PDF and metadata pins are fetched once per occurrence, including four identical PDF pins in a typical overview sheet. Their content-addressed output inputs remain in result/data_cache already, so repeated decompression is unnecessary if exact immutable source association is preserved.

The same twelve exact trace documents are decompressed and parsed once per selected full-page recipe. Only parsed.sha256 is used; cache the exact trace bytes/hash and this scalar, not a mutable parsed document.

recommended_change: Use a function-local immutable archive-object byte cache, seeded by the existing initial auxiliary copy, or reuse data_cache through a separate exact source-identity index. Bind keys to prior archive identity plus immutable object_path, sha256 and bytes; never to capture/work/build logical path alone.

Resolve each logical alias and retain existing blob/pdf_delta/primitive-kind and pin-to-source association checks on every call. Cache only after the existing object reader and SHA/size checks succeed. A mismatched repeated pin must still fail; keep all current per-call SHA/size comparisons for the first conservative implementation.

Use the cached exact bytes for fullpage PDF/ledger/trace and native PDF/metadata/canvas blob consumers. Keep the native_source_png reconstruction branch untouched, including its existing bounded dependency checks and prior.recipe_bytes calls.

Memoize trace parsing by verified immutable source-object identity. Preserve the per-recipe comparison of the cached parsed PDF SHA to the current recipe source SHA and the existing missing-trace behavior.

Still execute all add() conflict checks, descriptor construction, pin rewrites and provenance overwrites in the original loop/order. Do not short-circuit an entire preserve_native_pin call on a cache hit: source_recipe_id and insertion/last-write behavior must remain exact.

Do not cache the general initial current-file/PNG data() reads, do not skip initial current PNG hashing, and do not cache away any later mandatory fresh PNG reconstruction or exact PNG/RGB comparison.
expected_safety: Reusing immutable verified bytes and a derived parsed SHA can preserve exact expanded item bytes, recipe objects and inventory ordering. This is a reasoned code assessment, not an executed patched equivalence test. No code was changed.
focused_future_acceptance_if_implemented: Exact before/after expanded bytes and metadata equality on a bounded fixture containing repeated PDF/metadata/trace pins, aliases, an existing auxiliary path and two recipes that update the same provenance descriptor.
Wrong same-object hash/size, wrong logical-to-object association, and conflicting current auxiliary path still fail.
Instrumented fixture confirms one immutable decompression/trace parse per distinct pin while unchanged primitive and final fresh-render calls remain invoked.
runtime_limit: The measurements are exact metadata-based call/byte multiplication, not wall-clock profiling or proof that the active process is currently inside expand. No active process was interrupted or rerun.
mutation_scope: Only this recommendation and the referenced report were written, both under /tmp. No project, source, snapshot, stage, helper or running archive input was changed.
